# `agy-code-graph` — Native Antigravity Code Knowledge Graph Plugin

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![Google Antigravity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Antigravity-Plugin-4285F4?logo=google&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/JsonLee12138/agy-code-graph) [![MCP Compatible](https://img.shields.io/badge/MCP-Compatible-10B981)](https://modelcontextprotocol.io) [![Python 3.10+](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-3.10%2B-blue?logo=python&logoColor=white)](https://python.org) [![Parser: Tree-sitter](https://img.shields.io/badge/Parser-Tree--sitter-orange)](https://tree-sitter.github.io) [![Engine: code-review-graph](https://img.shields.io/badge/Engine-code--review--graph-8A2BE2)](https://github.com/tirth8205/code-review-graph) > [!NOTE] > **Languages**: **English** | [简体中文](README.zh.md) **`agy-code-graph`** is a native code knowledge graph plugin engineered for **Google Antigravity (AGY CLI / IDE / 2.0 / Python SDK)**, powered by [tirth8205/code-review-graph](https://github.com/tirth8205/code-review-graph) (Tree-sitter AST parsing + embedded SQLite graph database). Traditional AI coding assistants waste significant context window tokens by performing brute-force greps or reading whole files blindly. `agy-code-graph` enforces a **Graph-First Retrieval** and **Zero Double-Read** protocol: the AI agent queries the AST graph first to inspect call hierarchies, impact blast radius, and execution flows, reading only the exact line ranges when necessary. This drastically speeds up reasoning while preventing token exhaustion and hallucinations. --- ## Key Highlights ### 1. 100% Unfiltered MCP Tool Surface + Zero `cwd` Drift - **Zero Tool Castration or Proxy Overhead**: Directly mounts `code-review-graph serve` via `stdio`, exposing all 22+ upstream MCP tools and prompts (`get_minimal_context_tool`, `get_impact_radius_tool`, `semantic_search_nodes_tool`, `query_graph_tool`, `get_review_context_tool`, `detect_changes_tool`, `get_flow_tool`, `get_affected_flows_tool`, `get_architecture_overview_tool`, `list_communities_tool`, `refactor_tool`, `apply_refactor_tool`, `build_or_update_graph_tool`, etc.). - **Zero `cwd` Drift**: Plugin and workspace rules strictly mandate passing explicit `repo_root=""` on every call, eliminating working directory confusion across multi-root or subfolder sessions. ### 2. Decoupled Two-Tier Setup Skills - **`/agy-code-graph:crg-install` (Global CLI Installer)**: Detects runtime environments and installs or upgrades the `code-review-graph` CLI globally via `uv tool`, `pipx`, or `pip` without starting background daemons. - **`/agy-code-graph:crg-init` (Workspace Bootstrapper)**: Injects the graph-first workspace rule (`.agents/rules/crg.md`), configures `.gitignore`, installs an idempotent atomic-locked Git `post-commit` hook, and builds the initial `graph.db`. ### 3. Pure-CLI Lifecycle Sync (Deterministic, Zero Latency) - **`PostToolUse` (`mark-dirty`)**: Active only in initialized workspaces. Filters out external `` writes and marks `.code-review-graph/.dirty` in `~1ms`. - **`Stop` (`sync-on-stop`)**: Fires when the agent turns `fullyIdle: true`. Uses a POSIX atomic directory lock (`mkdir .code-review-graph/update.lock.d` with 10-minute stale lock auto-recovery) and completely detaches standard I/O streams (`>/dev/null 2>&1 scripts/crg-hook.sh"] end subgraph Workspace["Target Workspace"] Rule[".agents/rules/crg.md\n(Graph-First + Zero Double-Read)"] DB[".code-review-graph/graph.db\n(Tree-sitter AST SQLite Graph)"] Dirty[".code-review-graph/.dirty"] Lock[".code-review-graph/update.lock.d\n(POSIX mkdir Atomic Lock)"] GitHook[".git/hooks/post-commit"] end InstallSkill -->|"Global CLI Install\n(uv tool / pipx / pip)"| MCP InitSkill -->|"1. Inject Rules\n2. Setup Git Hook\n3. Initial Build"| Rule InitSkill --> GitHook InitSkill --> DB Hooks -->|"PostToolUse (edit/write)"| Dirty Hooks -->|"Stop (fullyIdle detached stream)"| Lock GitHook -->|"git commit"| Lock Lock -->|"Pure-CLI Incremental Update\n(update --base HEAD & update)"| DB MCP <-->|"Explicit repo_root"| DB ``` --- ## Quick Start ### 1. Install Plugin #### Option A: Install via Antigravity CLI (Recommended) Install directly from the GitHub repository URL: ```bash agy plugin install https://github.com/JsonLee12138/agy-code-graph.git ``` #### Option B: Clone into Plugins Directory Clone the repository directly into your Antigravity global plugins directory: ```bash git clone https://github.com/JsonLee12138/agy-code-graph.git ~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-code-graph ``` #### Verify Installation Verify the plugin is active and adheres to the strict Antigravity schema (0 errors, 0 warnings): ```bash # Verify plugin is registered agy plugin list # Validate plugin schema in strict mode agy plugin validate ~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-code-graph --strict ``` ### 2. Install `code-review-graph` CLI Globally Inside the Antigravity chat prompt: ```text /agy-code-graph:crg-install ``` Or execute directly in your shell: ```bash # Verify environment readiness bash scripts/install-crg.sh --check # Install or upgrade globally bash scripts/install-crg.sh ``` ### 3. Initialize Code Graph in Your Project Inside your project's Antigravity session: ```text /agy-code-graph:crg-init ``` Or run the initialization script directly: ```bash # Check repository status (returns JSON) bash scripts/init-crg.sh --check /path/to/your-repo # Bootstrap: inject rules, install post-commit hook & build initial graph bash scripts/init-crg.sh /path/to/your-repo # Optional: merge local lifecycle hooks into .agents/hooks.json bash scripts/init-crg.sh /path/to/your-repo --with-local-hooks ``` --- ## Bundled Skills Reference (9 Skills) | Slash Command / Skill | Origin | Purpose & Best Use Cases | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `/agy-code-graph:crg-install` | Plugin Native | Detects and globally installs or upgrades the `code-review-graph` CLI via `uv tool`, `pipx`, or `pip`. | | `/agy-code-graph:crg-init` | Plugin Native | Injects `.agents/rules/crg.md`, `.gitignore`, atomic `post-commit` hook, and builds the initial `graph.db`. | | `/agy-code-graph:build-graph` | Upstream Sync | Manually builds or updates the Tree-sitter AST knowledge graph for the active repository. | | `/agy-code-graph:explore-codebase` | Upstream Sync | Explores an unfamiliar repository via high-level architecture overview, code communities, and execution flows. | | `/agy-code-graph:review-changes` | Upstream Sync | Reviews uncommitted changes with blast-radius call-chain analysis and test gap detection. | | `/agy-code-graph:review-delta` | Upstream Sync | Reviews incremental code diffs since the last graph update for fast, low-token reviews. | | `/agy-code-graph:review-pr` | Upstream Sync | Performs deep structural review and blast-radius analysis across branch diffs or pull requests. | | `/agy-code-graph:refactor-safely` | Upstream Sync | Uses `refactor_tool` and `get_impact_radius_tool` to preview and safely execute cross-file renames and refactoring. | | `/agy-code-graph:debug-issue` | Upstream Sync | Diagnoses root causes along AST call hierarchies, dependency edges, and affected execution flows. | --- ## Key MCP Tools Reference The plugin passes through all tools from `code-review-graph serve`: | MCP Tool | Description | | :--- | :--- | | `get_minimal_context_tool` | Extracts concise structural context (signature, callers, callees, dependencies) for a given symbol. | | `get_impact_radius_tool` | Calculates the blast radius of changes to a function, class, or file (direct callers, indirect consumers, tests). | | `get_review_context_tool` | Generates structured review context including impacted entities, modified flows, and risk indicators. | | `semantic_search_nodes_tool` | Performs semantic search across graph nodes and symbols, with optional source snippet extraction. | | `query_graph_tool` | Queries the raw AST graph (filter by name, path, entity type, or edge relationships). | | `detect_changes_tool` | Detects workspace file modifications relative to the current indexed graph. | | `get_flow_tool` / `get_affected_flows_tool` | Traces critical execution flows and identifies flows affected by proposed edits. | | `get_architecture_overview_tool` | Returns high-level architectural decomposition and subsystem summaries. | | `list_communities_tool` | Displays detected code communities / modules using graph partitioning algorithms. | | `refactor_tool` / `apply_refactor_tool` | Previews and applies atomic cross-file symbol refactoring and renaming. | | `build_or_update_graph_tool` | Triggers a full build or incremental update of the repository graph. | > [!TIP] > Always pass `repo_root=""` when invoking MCP tools via agents or SDK scripts. --- ## Google Antigravity Python SDK Integration If building a custom agent with the `google-antigravity` Python SDK, mount the plugin's MCP server and lifecycle hooks directly: ```python import subprocess from pathlib import Path from antigravity import Agent, Hooks, McpStdioServer PLUGIN_ROOT = Path("~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-code-graph").expanduser() # 1. Mount the Code Review Graph MCP stdio server crg_mcp = McpStdioServer( name="agy-code-graph", command="code-review-graph", args=["serve"], ) # 2. Register non-blocking lifecycle hooks hooks = Hooks() @hooks.post_tool_call async def mark_graph_dirty(ctx): """Mark workspace dirty (~1ms) on write operations""" if ctx.tool_name in {"edit_file", "write_file", "create_file", "delete_file"}: subprocess.run( ["sh", str(PLUGIN_ROOT / "scripts/crg-hook.sh"), "mark-dirty"], input=ctx.to_json().encode("utf-8"), check=False, ) @hooks.stop async def sync_graph_on_stop(ctx): """Trigger detached non-blocking background incremental sync when fully idle""" subprocess.run( ["sh", str(PLUGIN_ROOT / "scripts/crg-hook.sh"), "sync-on-stop"], input=ctx.to_json().encode("utf-8"), check=False, ) # 3. Instantiate Agent agent = Agent( model="gemini-2.5-pro", mcp_servers=[crg_mcp], hooks=hooks, ) ``` --- ## Local Quality Gate & Integration Tests (Software 1.0 Gate) Run the comprehensive quality gate script locally before shipping: ```bash bash scripts/gate-check.sh ``` Verification pipeline: 1. **Gate 0/5**: Disk SSoT contracts verification (`.artifacts/SPEC.md`, `CONSTRAINTS.md`, `PLAN.md`). 2. **Gate 1/5**: Shell syntax validation for all POSIX `sh` and `bash` scripts (`sh -n` / `bash -n`). 3. **Gate 2/5**: Antigravity plugin schema strict validation (`agy plugin validate --strict`). 4. **Gate 3/5**: Upstream skills verification against official references. 5. **Gate 4/5**: 5 deterministic end-to-end integration tests (manifest schema, unfiltered MCP surface, decoupled install/init, boundary guards, and non-blocking stream detachment). 6. **Gate 5/5**: Secret scanning and absolute path leakage checks. --- ## License & Acknowledgements - Licensed under the [MIT License](LICENSE). - Core knowledge graph engine by [tirth8205/code-review-graph](https://github.com/tirth8205/code-review-graph). - Built for the [Google Antigravity](https://github.com/JsonLee12138/agy-code-graph) agentic coding ecosystem.

# `agy-code-graph` — Google Antigravity 原生代码知识图谱插件

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![Google Antigravity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Antigravity-Plugin-4285F4?logo=google&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/JsonLee12138/agy-code-graph) [![MCP Compatible](https://img.shields.io/badge/MCP-Compatible-10B981)](https://modelcontextprotocol.io) [![Python 3.10+](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-3.10%2B-blue?logo=python&logoColor=white)](https://python.org) [![Parser: Tree-sitter](https://img.shields.io/badge/Parser-Tree--sitter-orange)](https://tree-sitter.github.io) [![Engine: code-review-graph](https://img.shields.io/badge/Engine-code--review--graph-8A2BE2)](https://github.com/tirth8205/code-review-graph) > [!NOTE] > **语言 / Languages**: **简体中文** | [English](README.md) **`agy-code-graph`** 是专为 **Google Antigravity (AGY CLI / IDE / 2.0 / Python SDK)** 打造的高性能原生代码知识图谱插件。基于 [tirth8205/code-review-graph](https://github.com/tirth8205/code-review-graph)（Tree-sitter AST 语法树解析器 + SQLite 嵌入式图数据库）构建，为 AI 编程 Agent 提供精准、低成本的结构化代码感知能力。 传统 AI 编程助手通常依赖全盘扫描（Grep/Find）或盲目阅读整文件，极易消耗宝贵的上下文窗口（Context Window）并造成“幻觉”。`agy-code-graph` 践行 **Graph-First（图谱优先检索）** 与 **Zero Double-Read（零冗余复读）** 原则：让 Agent 优先向代码图谱查询精确的方法调用链路、影响半径（Blast Radius）与架构流（Flows），只在需要时精确按行切片读取代码，显著提升推理速度并大幅节省 Token。 --- ## 核心特性 (Key Highlights) ### 1. 100% 完整开放上游 MCP 工具集 + 彻底杜绝 `cwd` 漂移 - **零阉割、零代理**：通过 `stdio` 方式直接挂载 `code-review-graph serve`，完整开放上游全部 22+ 个 MCP 工具与 Prompts（涵盖 `get_minimal_context_tool`、`get_impact_radius_tool`、`semantic_search_nodes_tool`、`query_graph_tool`、`get_review_context_tool`、`detect_changes_tool`、`get_flow_tool`、`get_affected_flows_tool`、`get_architecture_overview_tool`、`list_communities_tool`、`refactor_tool`、`apply_refactor_tool`、`build_or_update_graph_tool` 等）。 - **零 `cwd` 漂移**：通过全局规则与工作区规则强制要求每次调用显式传入 `repo_root=""`，彻底解决多项目、多工作区下全局 MCP 进程的工作目录混乱问题。 ### 2. 职责清晰解耦的双安装与初始化技能 - **`/agy-code-graph:crg-install`（全局 CLI 安装器）**：仅专注检测环境并在全局通过 `uv tool` / `pipx` / `pip` 安装或升级 `code-review-graph` CLI（读取官方 GitHub 仓库说明，不常驻后台 Daemon）。 - **`/agy-code-graph:crg-init`（项目工作区初始化器）**：专注为目标 Git 仓库注入图谱优先规则（`.agents/rules/crg.md`）、配置 `.gitignore`、安装带原子文件锁的幂等 Git `post-commit` 钩子，并执行首次 `code-review-graph build`。 ### 3. 100% 纯 CLI 驱动的生命周期增量同步（极速、无阻塞） - **`PostToolUse` (`mark-dirty`)**：仅在已初始化的工作区生效；自动忽略工作区外的临时目录与 ``，耗时仅 `~1ms` 即可在 `.code-review-graph/.dirty` 标记脏状态。 - **`Stop` (`sync-on-stop`)**：当 Agent 结束本轮回答且进入 `fullyIdle` 状态时触发。通过 POSIX `mkdir .code-review-graph/update.lock.d` 原子目录锁（附带 10 分钟僵尸锁自愈机制）与 `>/dev/null 2>&1 scripts/crg-hook.sh"] end subgraph Workspace["目标项目工作区 (Target Workspace)"] Rule[".agents/rules/crg.md\n(Graph-First + Zero Double-Read)"] DB[".code-review-graph/graph.db\n(Tree-sitter AST SQLite 图谱)"] Dirty[".code-review-graph/.dirty"] Lock[".code-review-graph/update.lock.d\n(POSIX mkdir 原子锁)"] GitHook[".git/hooks/post-commit"] end InstallSkill -->|"全局 CLI 安装\n(uv tool / pipx / pip)"| MCP InitSkill -->|"1. 注入规则\n2. 安装 Git 钩子\n3. 首次全量构建"| Rule InitSkill --> GitHook InitSkill --> DB Hooks -->|"PostToolUse (edit/write)"| Dirty Hooks -->|"Stop (fullyIdle 脱离管道)"| Lock GitHook -->|"git commit"| Lock Lock -->|"纯 CLI 增量更新\n(update --base HEAD & update)"| DB MCP <-->|"显式传入 repo_root"| DB ``` --- ## 快速上手 (Quick Start) ### 1. 安装插件 #### 方式一：通过 Antigravity CLI 远程安装（推荐） 直接通过 GitHub 仓库地址使用 `agy` 命令行安装： ```bash agy plugin install https://github.com/JsonLee12138/agy-code-graph.git ``` #### 方式二：手动克隆至插件目录 直接克隆至 Antigravity 全局插件配置目录： ```bash git clone https://github.com/JsonLee12138/agy-code-graph.git ~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-code-graph ``` #### 验证安装状态 ```bash # 查看已安装插件列表 agy plugin list # 严格模式校验插件规范（0 报错、0 警告） agy plugin validate ~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-code-graph --strict ``` ### 2. 全局安装 `code-review-graph` CLI 在 Google Antigravity 对话框中键入： ```text /agy-code-graph:crg-install ``` 也可以直接在终端执行脚本： ```bash # 检查当前环境状态 bash scripts/install-crg.sh --check # 全局安装或升级 CLI bash scripts/install-crg.sh ``` ### 3. 在目标项目中初始化代码知识图谱 在目标项目的 Antigravity 对话中输入： ```text /agy-code-graph:crg-init ``` 或在终端中直接运行： ```bash # 检查目标仓库状态 bash scripts/init-crg.sh --check /path/to/your-repo # 一键初始化：注入规则 + 安装 post-commit 钩子 + 构建初次图谱 bash scripts/init-crg.sh /path/to/your-repo # 可选：同时将项目本地生命周期钩子合并注入至 .agents/hooks.json bash scripts/init-crg.sh /path/to/your-repo --with-local-hooks ``` --- ## 内置技能列表 (9 Bundled Skills) | 技能命令 (Slash / Skill) | 来源类型 | 核心功能与使用时机 | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `/agy-code-graph:crg-install` | 插件原生 | 自动检测并使用 `uv tool` / `pipx` / `pip` 全局安装或升级 `code-review-graph` CLI。 | | `/agy-code-graph:crg-init` | 插件原生 | 为当前项目注入 `.agents/rules/crg.md`、配置 `.gitignore`、配置原子锁 `post-commit` 钩子并构建首个 `graph.db`。 | | `/agy-code-graph:build-graph` | 上游官方同步 | 手动构建或增量更新当前代码库的 Tree-sitter AST 知识图谱。 | | `/agy-code-graph:explore-codebase` | 上游官方同步 | 基于图谱整体架构全景、业务社区（Communities）与核心调用链路（Flows）高效探索陌生项目。 | | `/agy-code-graph:review-changes` | 上游官方同步 | 针对工作区当前未提交的改动执行结构化审查，分析爆炸半径与测试覆盖率缺口。 | | `/agy-code-graph:review-delta` | 上游官方同步 | 仅审查自上一次图谱记录以来的增量代码差异，实现极速且低 Token 消耗的审查。 | | `/agy-code-graph:review-pr` | 上游官方同步 | 针对 Pull Request 或指定分支进行全局架构影响面分析与全面代码审查。 | | `/agy-code-graph:refactor-safely` | 上游官方同步 | 结合 `refactor_tool` 与 `get_impact_radius_tool` 安全预览、分析并执行跨文件重命名与重构。 | | `/agy-code-graph:debug-issue` | 上游官方同步 | 顺着 AST 调用拓扑链、依赖关系边与执行流快速定位 Bug 的根本诱因。 | --- ## 核心 MCP 工具速查 (Key MCP Tools) 插件通过 `mcp_config.json` 完整透传 `code-review-graph serve` 提供的全部工具： | 工具名称 | 核心能力 | | :--- | :--- | | `get_minimal_context_tool` | 输入目标函数或类名，提取精简上下文（声明、关键依赖、调用方、被调用方）。 | | `get_impact_radius_tool` | 计算特定符号或文件修改后的爆炸影响半径（直接调用、间接依赖、受影响测试）。 | | `get_review_context_tool` | 生成用于代码审查的结构化上下文（涉及实体、调用流变更、风险指数）。 | | `semantic_search_nodes_tool`| 语义检索代码图谱中的节点与符号，支持带代码源码片段输出。 | | `query_graph_tool` | 执行底层图谱查询（按名称、文件路径、类型、关系边筛选）。 | | `detect_changes_tool` | 检查工作区代码相对于已建图谱的增量变化。 | | `get_flow_tool` / `get_affected_flows_tool` | 查询系统核心执行流，以及某项变更波及到的业务流链路。 | | `get_architecture_overview_tool` | 获取代码库的高层架构概览与子系统划分。 | | `list_communities_tool` | 基于图算法（Louvain / 文件聚类）展示代码社区模块划分。 | | `refactor_tool` / `apply_refactor_tool` | 预览并原子应用跨文件的重构与符号重命名。 | | `build_or_update_graph_tool` | 触发图谱全量构建或增量更新。 | > [!TIP] > 每次通过 Agent 或 SDK 调用上述工具时，均需携带 `repo_root="<当前工作区根目录绝对路径>"`。 --- ## Google Antigravity Python SDK 集成示例 如果你正在基于 `google-antigravity` Python SDK 开发定制化 Agent，可直接挂载本插件的配置与生命周期脚本： ```python import subprocess from pathlib import Path from antigravity import Agent, Hooks, McpStdioServer PLUGIN_ROOT = Path("~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-code-graph").expanduser() # 1. 注册完整 Code Review Graph MCP stdio 服务 crg_mcp = McpStdioServer( name="agy-code-graph", command="code-review-graph", args=["serve"], ) # 2. 挂载高性能生命周期 Hooks hooks = Hooks() @hooks.post_tool_call async def mark_graph_dirty(ctx): """当 Agent 执行文件写操作时，快速标记脏状态 (~1ms)""" if ctx.tool_name in {"edit_file", "write_file", "create_file", "delete_file"}: subprocess.run( ["sh", str(PLUGIN_ROOT / "scripts/crg-hook.sh"), "mark-dirty"], input=ctx.to_json().encode("utf-8"), check=False, ) @hooks.stop async def sync_graph_on_stop(ctx): """当 Agent 完成回答且 fullyIdle 时，在后台非阻塞执行增量同步""" subprocess.run( ["sh", str(PLUGIN_ROOT / "scripts/crg-hook.sh"), "sync-on-stop"], input=ctx.to_json().encode("utf-8"), check=False, ) # 3. 实例化 Agent agent = Agent( model="gemini-2.5-pro", mcp_servers=[crg_mcp], hooks=hooks, ) ``` --- ## 本地质量门禁与端到端测试 (Software 1.0 Gate) 本项目具备严密的自动化质量保障体系。可在根目录下运行一键门禁脚本： ```bash bash scripts/gate-check.sh ``` 门禁执行内容： 1. **Gate 0/5**：校验 Disk SSoT 契约文件完整性（`.artifacts/SPEC.md`、`CONSTRAINTS.md`、`PLAN.md`）。 2. **Gate 1/5**：校验所有 Shell 脚本（POSIX `sh` 与 `bash`）语法严谨性（`sh -n` / `bash -n`）。 3. **Gate 2/5**：执行 Antigravity 插件 Schema 严格验证（`agy plugin validate --strict`）。 4. **Gate 3/5**：校验 7 大上游技能与官方源码的一致性与完整性。 5. **Gate 4/5**：运行 5 组确定性端到端集成测试（覆盖清单规范、MCP 开放度、初始化幂等性、边界守卫、后台非阻塞管道断开验证）。 6. **Gate 5/5**：敏感信息与硬编码绝对路径安全扫描。 --- ## # `agy-code-graph` — Native Antigravity Code Knowledge Graph Plugin

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![Google Antigravity](https://img.shields.io/badge/Antigravity-Plugin-4285F4?logo=google&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/JsonLee12138/agy-code-graph) [![MCP Compatible](https://img.shields.io/badge/MCP-Compatible-10B981)](https://modelcontextprotocol.io) [![Python 3.10+](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-3.10%2B-blue?logo=python&logoColor=white)](https://python.org) [![Parser: Tree-sitter](https://img.shields.io/badge/Parser-Tree--sitter-orange)](https://tree-sitter.github.io) [![Engine: code-review-graph](https://img.shields.io/badge/Engine-code--review--graph-8A2BE2)](https://github.com/tirth8205/code-review-graph) > [!NOTE] > **Languages**: **English** | [简体中文](README.zh.md) **`agy-code-graph`** is a native code knowledge graph plugin engineered for **Google Antigravity (AGY CLI / IDE / 2.0 / Python SDK)**, powered by [tirth8205/code-review-graph](https://github.com/tirth8205/code-review-graph) (Tree-sitter AST parsing + embedded SQLite graph database). Traditional AI coding assistants waste significant context window tokens by performing brute-force greps or reading whole files blindly. `agy-code-graph` enforces a **Graph-First Retrieval** and **Zero Double-Read** protocol: the AI agent queries the AST graph first to inspect call hierarchies, impact blast radius, and execution flows, reading only the exact line ranges when necessary. This drastically speeds up reasoning while preventing token exhaustion and hallucinations. --- ## Key Highlights ### 1. 100% Unfiltered MCP Tool Surface + Zero `cwd` Drift - **Zero Tool Castration or Proxy Overhead**: Directly mounts `code-review-graph serve` via `stdio`, exposing all 22+ upstream MCP tools and prompts (`get_minimal_context_tool`, `get_impact_radius_tool`, `semantic_search_nodes_tool`, `query_graph_tool`, `get_review_context_tool`, `detect_changes_tool`, `get_flow_tool`, `get_affected_flows_tool`, `get_architecture_overview_tool`, `list_communities_tool`, `refactor_tool`, `apply_refactor_tool`, `build_or_update_graph_tool`, etc.). - **Zero `cwd` Drift**: Plugin and workspace rules strictly mandate passing explicit `repo_root=""` on every call, eliminating working directory confusion across multi-root or subfolder sessions. ### 2. Decoupled Two-Tier Setup Skills - **`/agy-code-graph:crg-install` (Global CLI Installer)**: Detects runtime environments and installs or upgrades the `code-review-graph` CLI globally via `uv tool`, `pipx`, or `pip` without starting background daemons. - **`/agy-code-graph:crg-init` (Workspace Bootstrapper)**: Injects the graph-first workspace rule (`.agents/rules/crg.md`), configures `.gitignore`, installs an idempotent atomic-locked Git `post-commit` hook, and builds the initial `graph.db`. ### 3. Pure-CLI Lifecycle Sync (Deterministic, Zero Latency) - **`PostToolUse` (`mark-dirty`)**: Active only in initialized workspaces. Filters out external `` writes and marks `.code-review-graph/.dirty` in `~1ms`. - **`Stop` (`sync-on-stop`)**: Fires when the agent turns `fullyIdle: true`. Uses a POSIX atomic directory lock (`mkdir .code-review-graph/update.lock.d` with 10-minute stale lock auto-recovery) and completely detaches standard I/O streams (`>/dev/null 2>&1 scripts/crg-hook.sh"] end subgraph Workspace["Target Workspace"] Rule[".agents/rules/crg.md\n(Graph-First + Zero Double-Read)"] DB[".code-review-graph/graph.db\n(Tree-sitter AST SQLite Graph)"] Dirty[".code-review-graph/.dirty"] Lock[".code-review-graph/update.lock.d\n(POSIX mkdir Atomic Lock)"] GitHook[".git/hooks/post-commit"] end InstallSkill -->|"Global CLI Install\n(uv tool / pipx / pip)"| MCP InitSkill -->|"1. Inject Rules\n2. Setup Git Hook\n3. Initial Build"| Rule InitSkill --> GitHook InitSkill --> DB Hooks -->|"PostToolUse (edit/write)"| Dirty Hooks -->|"Stop (fullyIdle detached stream)"| Lock GitHook -->|"git commit"| Lock Lock -->|"Pure-CLI Incremental Update\n(update --base HEAD & update)"| DB MCP <-->|"Explicit repo_root"| DB ``` --- ## Quick Start ### 1. Install Plugin #### Option A: Install via Antigravity CLI (Recommended) Install directly from the GitHub repository URL: ```bash agy plugin install https://github.com/JsonLee12138/agy-code-graph.git ``` #### Option B: Clone into Plugins Directory Clone the repository directly into your Antigravity global plugins directory: ```bash git clone https://github.com/JsonLee12138/agy-code-graph.git ~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-code-graph ``` #### Verify Installation Verify the plugin is active and adheres to the strict Antigravity schema (0 errors, 0 warnings): ```bash # Verify plugin is registered agy plugin list # Validate plugin schema in strict mode agy plugin validate ~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-code-graph --strict ``` ### 2. Install `code-review-graph` CLI Globally Inside the Antigravity chat prompt: ```text /agy-code-graph:crg-install ``` Or execute directly in your shell: ```bash # Verify environment readiness bash scripts/install-crg.sh --check # Install or upgrade globally bash scripts/install-crg.sh ``` ### 3. Initialize Code Graph in Your Project Inside your project's Antigravity session: ```text /agy-code-graph:crg-init ``` Or run the initialization script directly: ```bash # Check repository status (returns JSON) bash scripts/init-crg.sh --check /path/to/your-repo # Bootstrap: inject rules, install post-commit hook & build initial graph bash scripts/init-crg.sh /path/to/your-repo # Optional: merge local lifecycle hooks into .agents/hooks.json bash scripts/init-crg.sh /path/to/your-repo --with-local-hooks ``` --- ## Bundled Skills Reference (9 Skills) | Slash Command / Skill | Origin | Purpose & Best Use Cases | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `/agy-code-graph:crg-install` | Plugin Native | Detects and globally installs or upgrades the `code-review-graph` CLI via `uv tool`, `pipx`, or `pip`. | | `/agy-code-graph:crg-init` | Plugin Native | Injects `.agents/rules/crg.md`, `.gitignore`, atomic `post-commit` hook, and builds the initial `graph.db`. | | `/agy-code-graph:build-graph` | Upstream Sync | Manually builds or updates the Tree-sitter AST knowledge graph for the active repository. | | `/agy-code-graph:explore-codebase` | Upstream Sync | Explores an unfamiliar repository via high-level architecture overview, code communities, and execution flows. | | `/agy-code-graph:review-changes` | Upstream Sync | Reviews uncommitted changes with blast-radius call-chain analysis and test gap detection. | | `/agy-code-graph:review-delta` | Upstream Sync | Reviews incremental code diffs since the last graph update for fast, low-token reviews. | | `/agy-code-graph:review-pr` | Upstream Sync | Performs deep structural review and blast-radius analysis across branch diffs or pull requests. | | `/agy-code-graph:refactor-safely` | Upstream Sync | Uses `refactor_tool` and `get_impact_radius_tool` to preview and safely execute cross-file renames and refactoring. | | `/agy-code-graph:debug-issue` | Upstream Sync | Diagnoses root causes along AST call hierarchies, dependency edges, and affected execution flows. | --- ## Key MCP Tools Reference The plugin passes through all tools from `code-review-graph serve`: | MCP Tool | Description | | :--- | :--- | | `get_minimal_context_tool` | Extracts concise structural context (signature, callers, callees, dependencies) for a given symbol. | | `get_impact_radius_tool` | Calculates the blast radius of changes to a function, class, or file (direct callers, indirect consumers, tests). | | `get_review_context_tool` | Generates structured review context including impacted entities, modified flows, and risk indicators. | | `semantic_search_nodes_tool` | Performs semantic search across graph nodes and symbols, with optional source snippet extraction. | | `query_graph_tool` | Queries the raw AST graph (filter by name, path, entity type, or edge relationships). | | `detect_changes_tool` | Detects workspace file modifications relative to the current indexed graph. | | `get_flow_tool` / `get_affected_flows_tool` | Traces critical execution flows and identifies flows affected by proposed edits. | | `get_architecture_overview_tool` | Returns high-level architectural decomposition and subsystem summaries. | | `list_communities_tool` | Displays detected code communities / modules using graph partitioning algorithms. | | `refactor_tool` / `apply_refactor_tool` | Previews and applies atomic cross-file symbol refactoring and renaming. | | `build_or_update_graph_tool` | Triggers a full build or incremental update of the repository graph. | > [!TIP] > Always pass `repo_root=""` when invoking MCP tools via agents or SDK scripts. --- ## Google Antigravity Python SDK Integration If building a custom agent with the `google-antigravity` Python SDK, mount the plugin's MCP server and lifecycle hooks directly: ```python import subprocess from pathlib import Path from antigravity import Agent, Hooks, McpStdioServer PLUGIN_ROOT = Path("~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-code-graph").expanduser() # 1. Mount the Code Review Graph MCP stdio server crg_mcp = McpStdioServer( name="agy-code-graph", command="code-review-graph", args=["serve"], ) # 2. Register non-blocking lifecycle hooks hooks = Hooks() @hooks.post_tool_call async def mark_graph_dirty(ctx): """Mark workspace dirty (~1ms) on write operations""" if ctx.tool_name in {"edit_file", "write_file", "create_file", "delete_file"}: subprocess.run( ["sh", str(PLUGIN_ROOT / "scripts/crg-hook.sh"), "mark-dirty"], input=ctx.to_json().encode("utf-8"), check=False, ) @hooks.stop async def sync_graph_on_stop(ctx): """Trigger detached non-blocking background incremental sync when fully idle""" subprocess.run( ["sh", str(PLUGIN_ROOT / "scripts/crg-hook.sh"), "sync-on-stop"], input=ctx.to_json().encode("utf-8"), check=False, ) # 3. Instantiate Agent agent = Agent( model="gemini-2.5-pro", mcp_servers=[crg_mcp], hooks=hooks, ) ``` --- ## Local Quality Gate & Integration Tests (Software 1.0 Gate) Run the comprehensive quality gate script locally before shipping: ```bash bash scripts/gate-check.sh ``` Verification pipeline: 1. **Gate 0/5**: Disk SSoT contracts verification (`.artifacts/SPEC.md`, `CONSTRAINTS.md`, `PLAN.md`). 2. **Gate 1/5**: Shell syntax validation for all POSIX `sh` and `bash` scripts (`sh -n` / `bash -n`). 3. **Gate 2/5**: Antigravity plugin schema strict validation (`agy plugin validate --strict`). 4. **Gate 3/5**: Upstream skills verification against official references. 5. **Gate 4/5**: 5 deterministic end-to-end integration tests (manifest schema, unfiltered MCP surface, decoupled install/init, boundary guards, and non-blocking stream detachment). 6. **Gate 5/5**: Secret scanning and absolute path leakage checks. --- ## License & Acknowledgements - Licensed under the [MIT License](LICENSE). - Core knowledge graph engine by [tirth8205/code-review-graph](https://github.com/tirth8205/code-review-graph). - Built for the [Google Antigravity](https://github.com/JsonLee12138/agy-code-graph) agentic coding ecosystem.
